cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(campus_inventory LANGUAGES CXX)

enable_testing()

add_library(inventory_core STATIC src/inventory.cpp)
target_include_directories(inventory_core PUBLIC include)

add_executable(inventory_tests tests/inventory_test.cpp)
target_link_libraries(inventory_tests PRIVATE inventory_core)

add_test(NAME inventory_tests COMMAND inventory_tests)
set_tests_properties(inventory_tests PROPERTIES FAIL_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "FAILED")
